label: preparing
what: A coordinated bread order / bread supply arrangement, reportedly discussed at the bakery. A bridge or port change was also rumored, but its details and whether it is actually being prepared are unconfirmed. The mayor was not told in advance; the baker, builder, freight operator, and innkeeper appear involved. No clear evidence identifies additional knowing helpers beyond those four; the neighbour only relayed rumor, and the secretary merely arranged the mayor's appointment.
